== Summary ==
Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 11: the slip of [[Luke Skywalker, Rebel Hero (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014), cropped at 300 dpi. It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may deploy from Reserve Deck (or lose 1 Force to deploy from Lost Pile) a blaster on Luke (V){{!}}Luke; reshuffle. While armed with a blaster, it may not be stolen and characters hit by Luke may not be used to satisfy attrition. Immune to attrition < 4.”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Not an official image file.''' Crop made 11 November 2026 for batch C2/C3 (swccg-guild/work#236). Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
